trigger_condition.value_trigger: Large-magnitude real or imaginary components, such as values around 1e20
trigger_condition.concrete_constraints: torch.sqrt on CPU complex tensors with large-magnitude real or imaginary components produces output that does not match numpy or another reference.

bug_oracle.description: torch.sqrt on CPU complex tensors with large-magnitude real or imaginary components returns inaccurate results compared with numpy.

harness_strategy.input_mutation: Vary complex real and imaginary components across logarithmic or exponential magnitude scales, including negative and pure imaginary values.
harness_strategy.tensor_construction: Build CPU complex64 and complex128 tensors with large-magnitude real and imaginary parts, including generated variants around extreme values such as 0-1e20j and -1e20-4988429.2j.
harness_strategy.constraint_injection: Target complex unary numerical operators on CPU and compare behavior across complex dtypes.
harness_strategy.operation_sequence: Apply torch.sqrt and similar complex numerical operators to generated complex tensors and collect outputs.
harness_strategy.oracle_construction: Compare operator outputs against NumPy or a higher-precision/triaged reference for the same complex inputs, flagging mismatches outside appropriate tolerance.
